whyUs.title: Modern technology, personal service
whyUs.subtitle: We have been building software for over a decade, keeping up with every new generation of tools.

items.title: Modern, maintainable technology
items.description: We moved from React 16 to React 19 and Tailwind 4. We use modern tools with long-term support.

items.title: Direct communication
items.description: You talk to the people building your project. No middlemen, no broken telephone.

items.title: Transparent pricing
items.description: Fixed price per phase or a block of hours. You know what you pay before we start.

items.title: Performance and SEO
items.description: Fast websites that score high on Core Web Vitals and rank better.

items.title: Secure by default
items.description: Client and server validation, robust authentication and OWASP best practices.

items.title: You own the code
items.description: Repository, documentation and deployment in your name. No lock-in.

stack.title: A production-proven stack
stack.subtitle: We pick every tool for its maturity, its community and how easy it will be to maintain five years from now.

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: It depends on scope, integrations and timeline. After a free first call we send you a fixed quote broken down by phase, so you know exactly what each part includes before we start.
A corporate website usually ships in 3 to 6 weeks. A custom application takes 2 to 4 months for the first version, with partial deliveries every two weeks so you see progress from the start.

items.q: Do you offer maintenance after launch?
items.a: Yes. Our monthly maintenance plans include security updates, backups, monitoring and a block of hours for improvements.

items.q: Can you take over an existing project?
items.a: Yes. We audit the current code, propose an improvement plan and evolve it or migrate it to modern technology step by step.
You do. At the end of each phase we hand over the source code, documentation and infrastructure access.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside Spain?
items.a: Yes. We work remotely in Spanish and English with companies anywhere in the world.

sections.heading: Website owner
sections.body: In accordance with Spanish Law 34/2002 on Information Society Services and Electronic Commerce (LSSI-CE), this website is owned by {owner}{taxId}{address}. You can contact us through the quote form{email}.

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.body: This website provides information about the software development, web design, systems integration, automation and technology consulting services offered by {owner}, and allows visitors to request quotes.

sections.heading: Intellectual and industrial property
sections.body: The content, design, logos and source code of this website are owned by {owner} or used under licence. Reproduction, distribution or transformation without express permission is prohibited.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: {owner} is not liable for misuse of the site content or for damages caused by technical interruptions beyond its control. Links to third-party sites are provided for information only.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by Spanish law. Any dispute shall be submitted to the competent courts in accordance with the law.

sections.heading: Data controller
sections.body: The controller of your personal data is {owner}{email}.

sections.heading: What data we process and why
sections.body: We process the data you provide in the quote form (name, email, company, phone and project description) solely to answer your request and, where applicable, to prepare and send you a commercial proposal.

sections.heading: Legal basis
sections.body: The legal basis is your consent, given by ticking the acceptance box, and taking pre-contractual steps at your request (Art. 6.1.a and 6.1.b GDPR).

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: We keep your data for as long as needed to handle your request and, if we work together, for the duration of the contract and applicable legal periods.

sections.heading: Recipients
sections.body: We do not share your data with third parties unless legally required. We use an email provider (Resend) that acts as a data processor with appropriate safeguards.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability by writing to us. You may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).

sections.heading: Which cookies we use
sections.body: This website only uses strictly necessary technical cookies, such as the one that remembers your chosen language (NEXT_LOCALE). We do not use analytics, advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Legal basis
sections.body: Technical cookies are exempt from consent under Article 22.2 of the LSSI-CE because they are strictly necessary to provide the service you request.

sections.heading: How to disable them
sections.body: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. If you do, the site may not remember your language preference.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: If we add other types of cookies in the future, we will update this policy and ask for your consent where required.
